sloka: तं पुत्रं दुर्विनीतं तु दृष्ट्वा क्रोधसमन्वितः ।मधुः स शोकमापेदे न चैनं किञ्चिदब्रवीत् ।। ७.६१.१९ ॥
transliteration: taṁ putraṁ durvinītaṁ tu dṛṣṭvā krodhasamanvitaḥ ।madhuḥ sa śokamāpede na cainaṁ kiñcidabravīt ।। 7.61.19 ॥

translations.english: Seeing his ill-behaved son, Madhu was filled with anger and sorrow, yet he did not say anything to him.
